camera_height_m: 0.35, at the watch braced against his chest
start_frame: Insert at close focus: the enamel watch dial and the chain, the fur and claws of a real rabbit's forepaw closed round it, warm passage lamplight on the enamel.
end_frame: The same frame held — the hands of the watch read and the paw tightening on it; his face never enters the shot.
constraint_honoured: 'The watch is read in ONE insert of the watch face and the paw, not on his face' — one fixed insert, no move and no macro, so the fur and the enamel stay in the same photographed world.
movement_note: 3.0 s buys one legible dial read; a move would turn a story insert into a product shot.
